about: Pro for an account with a grant ownerGrants/{uid} {pro: true} that only the Firebase console can write. Graded by gates/pairs/checks/pro-grant.sh: gate 167 (index.html's proWatch on stand-in snapshots, and the source and rule texts) and the rules emulator test in rules-test/ (Java and, once, the network; it runs in the build container). NOT COVERED: his phone after he adds his grant (the Pro features open, the offer gone) - his phone check after the landing.

breaks.name: any-truthy-grant
breaks.why: a grant of pro: "true" or 1 turns Pro on, so a grant is not exactly {pro: true}

breaks.name: grant-listener-leaks
breaks.why: signing out stops only the subscription listener and leaves the grant listener running

breaks.name: client-may-write-its-grant
breaks.why: the rules let a signed-in player create or change their own grant, so the app could turn Pro on
